The typical procedure for the synthesis of polymer ia is as follows: The monomer ia (400 mg, 0.67 mol) and AIBN (2 wt %) were dissolved in dry THF (5 mL) and gentle steam ofnitrogen purged into the solution. The solution was kept in an oil bath at $6 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$for 48 h. Then, the solution was cooled and poured into excess of methanol to precipitate the product. The typical procedure for the synthesis of polymer ia is as follows: The monomer ia (400 mg, 0.67 mol) and AIBN (2 wt %) were dissolved in dry THF (5 mL) and gentle steam ofnitrogen purged into the solution. The solution was kept in an oil bath at $6 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$for 48 h. Then, the solution was cooled and poured into excess of methanol to precipitate the product.
